The first release of Stage Manager for Windows, the macOS Stage Manager for Windows 10 and 11.

**Download `StageManager.exe` below and run it**, nothing to install. SmartScreen may warn about the unsigned exe: *More info* → *Run anyway*.

### Highlights

- Windows fly between the stage and the sidebar when switching, Alt+Tab and the taskbar switch stages too
- Tilted sidebar cards with one shared perspective, like on macOS
- Several apps per stage, pinned apps that stay on every stage, dragging files onto other stages
- Windows always come back when quitting or after a crash, quitting never hangs
- Exact on scaled screens, ignores hidden helper windows of other apps
- Windows 11 style tray menu following the light or dark theme

See the [README](https://github.com/sunmoyun0831-collab/smy-room#what-is-new-compared-to-the-original) for everything that changed compared to the original prototype by awaescher.

---

**中文**：第一个正式版本。下载下面的 `StageManager.exe` 直接运行即可（无需安装；若 SmartScreen 拦截，点「更多信息」→「仍要运行」）。主要内容：切换舞台时窗口飞行动画并兼容 Alt+Tab 和任务栏、macOS 式统一透视的倾斜卡片、一个舞台多个应用、固定应用、拖文件切换舞台、退出或崩溃时一定恢复所有窗口、高分屏准确、忽略其他软件的隐藏窗口、Windows 11 风格托盘菜单。
